project_type: Level 300 PoC — Azure Functions .NET 8 isolated + Azure Blob Storage vs AWS Lambda .NET 8 + S3, comparing AWS Transform Azure-to-AWS migration (AI vs manual). App: Cloud Migration Fortune API (クラウド移行診断おみくじAPI).
build_system: dotnet CLI. DOTNET_ROOT=/opt/homebrew/opt/dotnet@8/libexec. Dotnet binary: /opt/homebrew/opt/dotnet@8/libexec/dotnet. No dotnet templates pre-installed for Azure Functions or Lambda — write csproj files manually.
test_framework: No unit test framework. Build verification only: dotnet build must succeed with 'Build succeeded.' message.
environment_constraints: NEVER create any file under /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-transform-output/ or /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-lambda-transform/ — leave them completely empty. The workspace is NOT yet a git repo (no .git directory). Initialize git only at the end (FEAT-003 or finalize step). No cloud resources are created by this workflow.
contribution_requirements: No credentials, connection strings, or access keys in source. Use env vars: AzureWebJobsStorage (Azure Blob), S3_BUCKET_NAME (Lambda S3). All Bicep/SAM resources tagged. Cleanup scripts required. Measured vs estimated values clearly distinguished. PoC tag: project=atoa-poc.
key_patterns: Azure Functions .NET 8 isolated: OutputType=Exe, HostBuilder with ConfigureFunctionsWorkerDefaults(), [Function] attribute, HttpTrigger with HttpRequestData/HttpResponseData. Headers accessed as req.Headers.TryGetValues('X-Force-Seed', out IEnumerable<string>? seeds) — note plural TryGetValues. Lambda .NET 8: standard class library, [assembly: LambdaSerializer(...)], handler signature Task<APIGatewayHttpApiV2ProxyResponse> HandleAsync(APIGatewayHttpApiV2ProxyRequest, ILambdaContext). HTTP/2 headers are lowercase in API Gateway v2: check 'x-force-seed' (lowercase). Random: Random.Shared for unseeded; new Random(seed) when X-Force-Seed header present. FortuneEngine is pure logic (no I/O), independently implemented in both projects.
directory_structure: azure-app/src/ = Azure Functions C# source; azure-app/infra/bicep/ = Bicep IaC (main+storage+functions+params); azure-app/tests/ = empty; aws-lambda-manual/src/ = manual Lambda C# source; aws-lambda-manual/tests/ = empty; benchmark/ = test/perf shell scripts + test-cases.json; results/ = output JSON/CSV/MD (tracked, not gitignored); .agents/tasks/ = FEAT planning artifacts; aws-transform-output/ = MUST REMAIN EMPTY; aws-lambda-transform/ = MUST REMAIN EMPTY
